claim_text: A covering over Taiwan with people praying there, giving more time to the people of Taiwan, and liberation called over South Korea, China, the Philippines, North Korea and a great move of God in Japan.
quote: There's a covering over Taiwan. I see people praying in Taiwan
falsify_match: Taiwan remaining free longer than he expected.
falsify_miss: China takes it. Giving more time is the mechanism by which a delay is read as an answer.

claim_text: The same passage in the overlapping window, repeating the more time given to Taiwan and the list of Asian nations.
quote: Giving more time. Giving more time to the people of Taiwan
falsify_match: Same as the preceding row.
falsify_miss: Same as the preceding row.

claim_text: A great shaking taking place in Japan, all across the land.
quote: I see a great shaking taking place in Japan
falsify_match: A major Japanese earthquake.
falsify_miss: None. Japan records damaging quakes most years, so only an exceptional one would count.

claim_text: The same thing happening across Europe, and the Lord bringing a great shaking underneath the Vatican, under the dark rooms and caverns, to bring them to their knees, with great corruption and perversion exposed and justice for young people who cried out.
quote: I'm bringing a great shaking even underneath the Vatican
falsify_match: A major abuse disclosure centred on the Vatican.
falsify_miss: None. Vatican abuse disclosures have run for two decades, which is the base rate to exceed.

claim_text: Fifty four people said the prayer, and he says he believes this video alone will bring a hundred and fifty, with the reach placed across South Korea, Japan and the Philippines.
quote: I believe on this video alone we'll get 150
falsify_match: Nothing public would confirm it.
falsify_miss: Nothing public would refute it. He says himself that he always stretches the number out.

claim_text: Divine freedom for young people, God is not done with America, a great harvest of souls all around Canada, and a great revival beginning that will be seen soon, coming out of a great shaking.
quote: As a great revival is beginning, and you'll see it soon
falsify_match: Visible church growth in Canada and America.
falsify_miss: None. Soon carries no date, and the shaking is required first.

claim_text: A prayer that the president hears the Lord's voice and no stranger's, sleeps sound and uninterrupted unhindered by any satanic or demonic force, takes no counsel from the ungodly, and that the bombing and the smoke he saw coming out of the boats in the strait does not happen.
quote: that he sleeps sound uninterrupted and unhindered by any satanic
falsify_match: Tankers burning in the strait.
falsify_miss: None. He prays against the thing he says he was shown, which makes either outcome usable.

claim_text: Oil shot to a hundred and twenty dollars a barrel, then fell back when the president said the war was over and that sanctions would be lifted for trade with Russia, which he reads as being about the midterms and avoiding gas queues and ten dollar a gallon petrol.
quote: all these people with $10 a gallon gas
falsify_match: American petrol reaching ten dollars a gallon.
falsify_miss: It stays far below. He has given eight dollars elsewhere, so the figure moves upward here.

claim_text: It was not tested and they do not know whether it will work but all believe it will, and they only have one, which he believes was nuclear, comparing it to Hiroshima which was an atom bomb rather than the large ones held now.
quote: We only have one
falsify_match: A single completed untested Iranian device found.
falsify_miss: None found. He supplies the nuclear reading himself, saying he believes that is what it was.

claim_text: The scientist and a man in a black turban discuss what bigger artillery they have underground, preparing a surprise attack on Israel with biological weapons, with containers underground separated out by orange, three different kinds, one a mustard yellow substance in a black drum.
quote: getting ready for a surprise at- attack against Israel with biological weapons
falsify_match: Three distinct chemical or biological agents found stored underground in Iran.
falsify_miss: None found. The three kinds and the colours are the identifying details.

claim_text: The drums were black, some big and some small, and he believes the site is under a mountain in the northeast, working out on air with a map whether that would be nearer Afghanistan or Turkmenistan.
quote: this is under a mountain in the northeast area
falsify_match: A weapons site found in north-eastern Iran.
falsify_miss: The sites are elsewhere. He works the geography out on air and says he is not familiar with the area.

claim_text: In the vision he saw mountains and kept seeing northeast, with great facilities underneath them.
quote: It was underneath these mountains. Great facilities
falsify_match: Large undisclosed underground facilities in north-eastern Iran.
falsify_miss: None found there. The known enrichment sites are in the centre and north-west of the country.

claim_text: America's new weaponry, which nobody but Israel has seen, given by supernatural wisdom to liberate nations oppressed over religious freedom including Venezuela, Cuba, North Korea, Iran and Pakistan, described as stronger than nuclear but water-based, a splitting of water.
quote: something that was stronger than nuclear, but it was water-based
falsify_match: A weapon of that description disclosed.
falsify_miss: None disclosed. A weapon stronger than nuclear would be unmistakable if it existed.

claim_text: It was achieved only by the hand of God, and the Lord has made it so China cannot touch it, holding it back and putting it on certain minds.
quote: I have re- made it where China has not been able to touch this
falsify_match: Nothing observable, unless the weapon is disclosed.
falsify_miss: Nothing observable. Being hidden from China is not a checkable condition.

claim_text: The technological advancements are so overpowering that Macron is alarmed by what has never been shown and is about to be released, concerning Cuba, with the Secretary of State helping liberate Cuba, Venezuela and Mexico, putting people in authority and establishing the economy, with new resorts, golf courses, hotels and a tourist industry.
quote: I saw new resorts for vacation. Economic growth out of Cuba with golf courses
falsify_match: Golf resorts and hotels built in Cuba under American investment.
falsify_miss: None built. Golf courses are the new element, and Cuba has two.

claim_text: A revolt in Cuba because the people wanted freedom for the first time in decades, with blessing and increase coming, and guerrilla warfare out of Brazil and Colombia against the oil wells, with drug lords blackmailing families.
quote: the guerrilla warfare coming out of Brazil and Colombia to attack the oil wells
falsify_match: Irregular fighters from those countries attacking oil infrastructure.
falsify_miss: None. Brazil is an unusual source to name for this, which makes it more falsifiable than Colombia alone.

claim_text: Young men who did not want to fight but knew the terrain were sent against the Venezuelan oil wells, under threats to their families of torture or worse.
quote: I saw young men that didn't want to fight
falsify_match: Coerced fighters used against oil installations in Venezuela.
falsify_miss: None. The coercion detail is what distinguishes this from ordinary cartel violence.

claim_text: The Iranian leader communicates with the cells in America telephone to telephone on rotary phones, old technology that cannot easily be tracked because nobody is watching it, outsmarting the smart with dumb technology, with a line running across America.
quote: but it was a rotary phone
falsify_match: A covert network run over legacy telephone lines disclosed.
falsify_miss: None disclosed. He names the code talkers of the second world war as Cherokee, where the famous ones were Navajo.

claim_text: U-Haul trucks with fertiliser as in the Oklahoma City bombing, dams, the Las Vegas strip, and Boston, New York, Philadelphia and Chicago each with over a hundred men stationed there waiting on a phone call, aimed at hotels, Trump towers and key landmarks.
quote: each one of these cities had over 100 men that were stationed there
falsify_match: Networks of that size found in those cities.
falsify_miss: None found. Over a hundred operatives per city in five cities is a number that could not stay hidden.

claim_text: They take strategic orders rather than going rogue because they are not terrorists, and the Lord said this is an invasion from another nation rather than terrorism, made possible by four years of open borders, with China running secret groups too.
quote: You are not looking at terrorist. You're looking at an invasion
falsify_match: State-directed operatives found to have entered over that period.
falsify_miss: None. Framing it as an invasion rather than terrorism raises rather than lowers what would have to be shown.

claim_text: The Secretary of State has slain his tens of thousands, and a competitiveness is coming between two men, one moving with the hand of the Lord to liberate South America and Cuba and the other a tail rider taking the draft of somebody else.
quote: I saw a competitiveness coming between two men
falsify_match: A visible rivalry between the Secretary of State and another senior figure.
falsify_miss: None. Only one of the two men is named, which is what limits it.

claim_text: Because of the strife in the department a house divided cannot stand, and he saw a line dividing America that looked like a lightning bolt with blue against red.
quote: I saw a line dividing America last night that looked like a lightning bolt
falsify_match: A formal or violent political split in America.
falsify_miss: None. He declares against a civil war elsewhere while describing the division here.

claim_text: Great economic blessing comes out of Cuba, there will be a new leader over Mexico, and things happen at night with the Cuban grid going down.
quote: There'll be uh a new leader over Mexico in the days ahead
falsify_match: A change of Mexican leadership alongside Cuban blackouts.
falsify_miss: The Mexican president serves to 2030. Cuban blackouts were already routine when he said this.

claim_text: Within a twenty four hour period, though not necessarily the next twenty four hours, Cuba will be liberated and it will be all over the news, and prayer is still needed against weapons of mass destruction against Israel out of Damascus, which becomes a ruinous heap.
quote: within a 24-hour period, Cuba will be liberated
falsify_match: A Cuban change of government completed inside a day.
falsify_miss: A slow transition, or none. He removes the near-term deadline himself, as he does in the later telling.

claim_text: He points to the president posting a Kim Clement video that day, which he says shows he knows the prophetic and is hungry and looking for guidance, giving them a window to pray, and says they are not done with Iran because the weapons under the mountain must be finished.
quote: HE WATCHED KIM CLEMENT
falsify_match: The post exists as described.
falsify_miss: It does not. He reads a single social media post as evidence the president seeks prophetic guidance.

claim_text: A flag above the world in green, white and black with sickle swords and palm leaves, where the green represents Hamas, Al-Qaeda and ISIS, and an Iranian summit calls those people up to ask whether they will help distribute the weapons.
quote: I saw Iran summit calling these people up
falsify_match: Iranian transfer of unconventional weapons to those groups.
falsify_miss: None. Al-Qaeda and Iran have been adversaries as often as partners, which cuts against the pairing.

claim_text: They did not want America and Israel to find the weapons so they were willing to hand them to Hamas, Al-Qaeda and other organisations to distribute in the still of the night before the military destroyed them, and afterwards the Antichrist honours the group with the stripe on the flag.
quote: Trying to give these weapons away before they were destroyed
falsify_match: Unconventional weapons traced from Iran to those groups.
falsify_miss: None traced. Distribution in the still of the night is untestable as stated.

claim_text: They worship at places like this all around America, pointing to one in Oklahoma whose sign he says reads backwards, and he says it is coming sooner than people realise.
quote: they worship all places like this all around America
falsify_match: The compulsory Friday worship he describes elsewhere.
falsify_miss: None. What he points to is an existing place of worship, not a change.

claim_text: Earthquakes in Italy from an underwater volcano right off the coast, which causes a tsunami wave that kills three hundred thousand people in a single moment, and he points to a 6.0 eight miles off the Italian coast that day at 6:03 in the evening as the start of the signs.
quote: a tsunami wave that kills 300,000 people in just a single moment
falsify_match: A tsunami on the Italian coast with mass casualties.
falsify_miss: None. Three hundred thousand would be among the deadliest natural disasters in recorded history.

claim_text: Pressure on the earth with the sun becoming very active and major earthquakes, war and birth pains together, with Italy, the Ring of Fire and Japan to watch, Japan divided and a mountain blowing its top, and a massive volcano off the Oregon coast sending a tsunami inland into Portland.
quote: off the coast of Oregon, I saw a massive volcano going off
falsify_match: A submarine eruption off Oregon with a tsunami into Portland.
falsify_miss: None. Portland lies about eighty miles inland up a river, which is what a tsunami would have to reach.

claim_text: He shows the earthquake location again, right out in the water just as the Lord said, a 6.0 that happened that day, and says it is something to do with volcanoes.
quote: Right out in the water, just like the Lord said, a 6.0
falsify_match: The earlier recordings place an offshore Italian event before this quake.
falsify_miss: They do not. A 6.0 offshore is far from the tsunami and the three hundred thousand dead he described.

claim_text: If there are many tremors and smoke starts, take heed, because this will be a major end-time event, though he does not know when it will happen and only sees and hears in part.
quote: this is going to be a major event, an end-time event
falsify_match: A major Italian eruption.
falsify_miss: None. He removes the timing himself, which leaves only the event.

claim_text: Authority taken over storms across Alabama, Texas, Arkansas, northern Louisiana, Missouri, Kansas, the Texas panhandle and Nebraska, where he saw two twin tornadoes over Omaha, and a declaration that there will not be an active tornado season.
quote: I saw two twin tornadoes over Omaha, Nebraska
falsify_match: Twin tornadoes at Omaha, or a quiet 2026 season.
falsify_miss: Both cannot hold: he sees the tornadoes and then declares the season a dud, and the record will settle it.

claim_text: The blood pleaded over weather modification and manipulation, the storm season called a dud with no destructive or long-track tornadoes and no massive hail, only beautiful grey rain, and the back of the drought broken so the lakes and crops have water.
quote: we call this storm season a dud
falsify_match: A below-average 2026 tornado season with drought relief.
falsify_miss: An active season. Both halves are measured publicly, which makes this scoreable.

claim_text: A prayer over the hurricane season naming Tampa, Florida, the Carolinas, Virginia, Atlanta, Mississippi, Georgia, Louisiana, Texas and the Caribbean, that there be no great hurricanes this year and that it be a year of peace rather than destruction.
quote: THAT THERE'S NOT GREAT major hurricanes this year
falsify_match: A quiet 2026 Atlantic hurricane season with no major landfalls.
falsify_miss: A major hurricane strikes. The season is measured publicly and runs June to November.

claim_text: He speaks of being called to the kingdom for such a time as this and to be salt and light, then returns to the earthquakes and volcanoes on the Italian coastline and the 6.0 that day.
quote: we're called to the kingdom for such a time as this
falsify_match: Nothing. Exhortation with a recap of the Italian material.
falsify_miss: Nothing new is claimed here.

claim_text: It only buys time because retaliation is coming, but there is a window for the revival of Iran, with the grey-haired prince seen again, the man with the black hat to be eliminated and key leaders still to go, taken out by Israel, leaving stability and a window for a great harvest.
quote: They're going to eliminate the man with the black hat
falsify_match: Further Israeli killings of named Iranian leaders followed by an opening.
falsify_miss: None. The black hat and the grey hair are the only identifiers given.

claim_text: He watches the Ezekiel 38 and 39 war take place on the timeline with Russia involved, says some weapons stay hidden and not all will be found, more leaders are removed, and Turkey becomes restless, beating its war drums and blocking off the way to the Black Sea.
quote: I saw Turkey becoming restless, beating its war drums
falsify_match: Turkey closing the straits beyond the Montreux terms.
falsify_miss: It does not. Saying some weapons stay hidden means a failure to find them confirms rather than refutes.

claim_text: Strategic steps are still coming, it is not microwave as people think, and the president turns back to Cuba, taking territory as in the game Risk but in the spirit realm rather than the natural.
quote: We think it's microwave. It's not
falsify_match: Nothing. A framing of how he reads the moves.
falsify_miss: Nothing. Placing it in the spirit realm removes it from the record.

claim_text: Quoting James 5:7 about setting up for the harvest, he says the Iran war is leading to Ezekiel 38 and 39 and that a revival will break forth among the Iranian people if the underground church takes it, and that the man already there, the one with the black helmet, is about to be taken out.
quote: This man that's already there is about to be taken out
falsify_match: That leader removed and church growth following.
falsify_miss: He remains. The condition on the underground church means a failure of revival can be laid at their door.

claim_text: They put another man in as a proxy government, the grey-haired man is short-lived and taken out, and only then does Ezekiel 38 and 39 come, because it is not time yet and revival breaks through in Iran first.
quote: It will be a proxy government
falsify_match: That sequence: proxy government, short reign, then the prophesied war.
falsify_miss: A different order. He says himself that maybe he should not lay out a timeline.

claim_text: The senior adviser is seen discussing the golf course on Gaza, getting ready for the third temple to be rebuilt, and he guesses the whole thing takes less than ten years, though it could be three, two or tomorrow.
quote: I don't know less than 10
falsify_match: A third temple begun within ten years.
falsify_miss: None begun. He gives four different horizons in one breath, which removes any usable bound.

claim_text: The senior adviser is used as an errand boy for the Antichrist to fulfil his agendas before he steps in, a forerunner alongside Macron, with Macron taking Europe as his own sector and the adviser taking Israel and the Middle East.
quote: being an errand boy for the the Antichrist to fulfil his agendas
falsify_match: Those two men taking those two portfolios.
falsify_miss: They do not. The division into sectors is the specific part and is checkable against actual roles.

claim_text: Concerning Cuba he saw a beautiful white house with clay tiles rather than modern asphalt shingles, looking like a mansion.
quote: It looked like a mansion in Cuba
falsify_match: A residence of that description identified in Cuba.
falsify_miss: None. Clay tiled roofs are the norm across the island, which weakens the identification.

claim_text: Underneath the mansion are tunnels running in different directions to a bunker inside the side of a mountain, with further tunnels leading to an escape route for a boat.
quote: There was an escape route that went to a bunker
falsify_match: Tunnels and a mountain bunker found under a Cuban residence.
falsify_miss: None found. The boat escape ties this to the fleeing leader material.
